No. The land-change method could not evaluate this property (ASSET-J). The zonal statistics step returned an error: the source coverage the asset needs had not been prepared, so no observation was made.

This means there are no results at all, and the absence of results should not be read as "no land change found." The run metadata also lists no asset area, so the property's extent isn't recorded in this output.

The run (run-1, 12 November 2026) used the TerraUY land-change engine, an early-access version. It was set up to compare against a 31 December 2020 baseline, using Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change and the JRC 2020 forest cover reference.

To get an assessment, the source coverage for this asset needs to be prepared and the analysis rerun. Until then, the property remains unassessed.
